title: Principal Software Engineer
jobDescription: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Opening Paragraph: The Emergency Preparedness & Response (EP&R) team builds the systems that keep critical operations running when it matters most. When storms and severe weather threaten communities and infrastructure across the US, our platform enables customers to rapidly procure, mobilize, and manage the workforce needed to respond to and recover from storm damage — often under tight timelines and high-stakes conditions. We are looking for a Principal Engineer who is deeply hands-on, works backward from customer pain points and business needs, and measures success by impact rather than lines of code shipped. You will be the technical anchor of the team: a backend-heavy full-stack engineer who knows our systems inside and out, reasons rigorously about trade-offs, and raises the engineering bar for everyone around you while leading the team toward outcomes that genuinely matter. Duties & Responsibilities: Own the technical vision and architecture for EP&R systems, ensuring they are highly available, resilient, and easy to operate during peak-demand emergency events. Work backward from customer pain points and business goals to define the right problems to solve before writing a single line of code. Stay deeply hands-on — design, build, review, and debug across the stack (backend-heavy, with full-stack breadth) while setting the standard for engineering quality. Break down ambiguous, complex problems into well-scoped, achievable pieces that the team can execute against with clarity. Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers; set technical direction, unblock people, and cultivate a culture of ownership and high standards. Design with non-functional requirements front of mind — availability, scalability, latency, reliability, cost, and maintainability — and hold the team accountable to them. Define and drive the metrics that matter, using data to guide decisions, validate impact, and continuously improve system and team performance. Partner closely with product, operations, and business stakeholders to align engineering investment with real customer and business outcomes. Anticipate failure modes and design for operational excellence, including readiness for surge scenarios during active storm events. Champion the adoption of AI-powered tools and workflows to accelerate development, improve quality, and increase the team's leverage. Required Skills & Experience: 6–8 years of demonstrable software development experience, including 2–3 years leading a team. Strong proficiency in high-level programming languages such as Python, Java, or JavaScript, with backend-heavy full-stack capability. Proven experience building highly available, maintainable, and scalable systems in production. Deep understanding of non-functional requirements (availability, scalability, reliability, latency, cost, maintainability) and how to design for them. A metric-driven mindset — you instrument, measure, and let data drive decisions. Exceptional problem-solving ability and rigorous reasoning about system behavior and trade-offs. Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring engineering teams and delivering results through others. Ability to decompose complex, ambiguous problems into smaller, achievable deliverables. A self-starter who operates with a high degree of autonomy and ownership. An "AI-ready" engineer who actively leverages AI tools to boost personal and team productivity. Preferred Skills & Experience: Experience building systems that operate under high-stakes, time-sensitive, or surge-driven conditions (e.g., emergency response, logistics, on-demand marketplaces, or workforce/staffing platforms). Familiarity with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Experience with observability, on-call, and operational excellence practices for mission-critical services. Track record of influencing technical direction across teams and mentoring senior engineers. Exposure to workforce management, procurement, or supply/demand matching domains. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. You'll report to our Lead PM and partner closely with engineering teams in Bangalore and Thailand. The role is intentionally placed in Bangalore for time zone alignment and collaboration with both teams. As a core member of EP&R product - your primary focus will be our Storm Manager, Storm Impact, and Callout applications, with opportunities to contribute to platform initiatives as we build more horizontal capabilities across EP&R and adjacent product lines. Organized under pressure. You keep dependencies visible and priorities tight across distributed teams without becoming a bottleneck. Adaptable. title: Staff Software Engineer
jobDescription: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. About the Role We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer with a strong foundation in distributed systems, clean architecture, and performance-oriented design. You’ll focus primarily on building reliable, scalable, and maintainable backend services that power end-to-end features across multiple platforms. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on solving system-level challenges, understands database and API design fundamentals, and values code quality and operational excellence. Key Responsibilities ● Design and develop highly available, performant, and fault-tolerant backend systems and APIs. ● Apply SOLID principles and clean architecture to ensure modular and maintainable services. ● Own components end-to-end — from design, implementation, testing, deployment, to monitoring. ● Optimize database design and queries; ensure efficient indexing, replication, and scaling. ● Implement proper error handling, logging, and observability mechanisms (metrics, tracing). ● Collaborate closely with frontend and DevOps teams to define clear API contracts and deployment workflows. ● Ensure secure handling of data and credentials using industry-standard practices. ● Write comprehensive unit and integration tests, and participate in code and design reviews. ● Continuously improve system reliability, scalability, and developer experience. Required Skills ● 4–8 years of hands-on experience in frontend development.
